name: Connors Cumulative RSI(3) of 3 days threshold system
author: Pine community script (Cumulative RSI Strategy)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Compute RSI(3); cumulative RSI = sum of RSI(3) over last 3 bars. Enter long when cumulative RSI crosses UP through 60 (= 3 bars x oversold input 20); optional filter close > EMA(100).
exit: Close long when cumulative RSI crosses up through 282 (= 3 x input 94).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Optional EMA(100) trend filter (input TrendFilter, default false)
implementation_notes: Script scales levels as cumlen*level (60 trigger, 282 exit); source variable names are swapped (os=entry, ob=exit). Entry is a cross-UP of the cumulative sum through the low level, so it buys after the sum begins recovering, unlike the original Connors < threshold buy. Connors original uses cumulative RSI(2) of 2 days < 35; this is a variant.
